summary: Implemented backend auth API with user registration, login with JWT tokens, and password reset via SMS. Created password hashing utility (bcryptjs, salt rounds 10), JWT token utility (24h expiration, signed with SECRET_KEY), in-memory user store with phone_number as unique ID, and four serverless API endpoints: register, login, request-password-reset (6-digit code via Textbelt SMS, 15-min expiry), and reset-password (validates code expiration, updates hashed password).
